name: wang-genealogy
description: Provenance-first knowledge base for the historical genealogy of the Wang (王) surname

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy --workspace apps/api && npm run deploy --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/i18n/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/validation/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
